sents.zh: 中国很大，北边和南边离得很远。
sents.en: China is large, and the north and south are far apart.

sents.zh: 北边天气冷，南边天气热。
sents.en: The north is cold and the south is hot.

sents.zh: 南边的田里可以种很多稻子。
sents.en: A great deal of rice can be grown in the southern fields.

sents.zh: 可是要把米送到北边去，非常不方便。
sents.en: But getting that rice to the north was very inconvenient.

sents.zh: 走路要很多天，而且路上不安全。
sents.en: It took many days on foot, and the road was not safe.

sents.zh: 隋朝的皇帝想到了一个大办法。
sents.en: The Sui emperor thought of a great plan.

sents.zh: 他决定建一条很长很长的河。
sents.en: He decided to make a very long waterway.

sents.zh: 这条河从南边一直到北边。
sents.en: This waterway ran all the way from the south to the north.

sents.zh: 很多人来做这个工作，用了很多年。
sents.en: Many people came to do the work, and it took many years.

sents.zh: 工作又累又难，有的人再也没有回家。
sents.en: The work was hard and tiring, and some never went home again.

sents.zh: 不过做完以后，南北就近了很多。
sents.en: But once it was finished, north and south were much closer.

sents.zh: 商人坐船，可以把东西送到很远的地方。
sents.en: Merchants could go by boat and send goods far away.

sents.zh: 因为船比走路快，所以东西也便宜了。
sents.en: Because a boat is faster than walking, goods became cheaper too.

sents.zh: 河的两边慢慢有了很多城。
sents.en: Cities slowly grew up along both banks.

sents.zh: 一千四百年过去了，今天人们还在用这条河。
sents.en: Fourteen hundred years have passed, and people still use it today.
